per_rule.rule: S_N must not be null
S_N must be unique across all records
Every S_N in Acc_Info_dirty must exist in Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N
Account_No must not be null
Account_No must be a 4-digit code
Account_No should be unique (allowing for valid business duplicates only)
Full_Name must not be null
Full_Name must be in Title Case (excluding lowercase particles bin, binte, d/o, s/o)
Full_Name must not contain leading, trailing, or double internal whitespace
ID must not be null
ID must match Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S/T/F/G), 7 digits, one checksum letter
JoinDate must not be null
JoinDate must be a parseable date string
JoinDate must not be in the future
LastLogin must be a parseable date string
LastLogin must not be in the future
Subscription_Type must be one of: Basic, Free, Gold, Platinum, Premium
SubscriptionFee must not be null
SubscriptionFee must be parseable as a number (or the literal 'free')
SubscriptionFee must not contain sentinel placeholder values
SubscriptionFee must be non-negative
Status must use the dominant boolean representations True or False
AccountBalance must not contain sentinel placeholder 99999.0
AccountBalance must not be negative unless representing valid overdraft
PreferredLanguage must be one of: English, French, German, Malay, Tamil
Device must be one of: Desktop, Mobile, Tablet
OS must be one of the canonical values: Android, iOS, Linux, Windows, macOS
FeedbackScore must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
FeedbackScore1 must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
JoinDate must be on or before LastLogin
When Subscription_Type is 'Free', SubscriptionFee must be 0, null, or the literal 'free'
FeedbackScore and FeedbackScore1 must be equal (duplicate column check)
Full_Name must match the corresponding Name in Cust_Bio_dirty after standardizing casing and whitespace
ID must exactly match ID_No in Cust_Bio_dirty for the same S_N
Gender particles in Full_Name must be consistent with Gender in Cust_Bio_dirty: Bin/s/o indicates Male, Binte/d/o indicates Female
FeedbackScore must not contain sentinel placeholder values
